description: This file defines a utility object 'SplitUtils' that provides a method to split a string into tokens based on space characters, returning a LinkedList of valid tokens. It includes internal helper methods for validation and addition of tokens.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A Kotlin object providing string splitting utilities.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on spaces and returns a LinkedList of valid tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it passes validation (non-empty).

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is valid, currently ensuring it is not empty.
